properties.description: Child Pipeline 1: Ingests data from On-Premises SQL Server (DemoDB) to ADLS Gen2 Landing Zone partitioned by YYYY/MM/DD.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Child1_Source_To_Landing'', @TableID = ', string(pipeline().parameters.TableID), ', @TableName = ''', pipeline().parameters.SourceTableName, ''', @LoadType = ''', pipeline().parameters.LoadType, '''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS RunId;')
@concat('SELECT * FROM [', pipeline().parameters.SourceSchema, '].[', pipeline().parameters.SourceTableName, ']')
@concat('SELECT ISNULL(WatermarkValue, ''1900-01-01 00:00:00'') AS WatermarkValue FROM [dbo].[WatermarkTable] WHERE TableID = ', string(pipeline().parameters.TableID))

@concat('SELECT * FROM [', pipeline().parameters.SourceSchema, '].[', pipeline().parameters.SourceTableName, '] WHERE [', pipeline().parameters.WatermarkColumn, '] > ''', activity('Lookup_Get_Watermark').output.firstRow.WatermarkValue, '''')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = ', coalesce(variables('RowsCopied'), '0'), ', @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Child 1 Source to Landing Ingestion Failed''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Child Pipeline 2: Processes landed pipe-delimited CSV data from Landing container into Bronze Parquet files (Full load) or executes Databricks Job to perform DQ checks and upsert Delta tables in Bronze layer (Incremental), returning updated watermark value.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Child2_Landing_To_Bronze_Raw'', @TableID = ', string(pipeline().parameters.TableID), ', @TableName = ''', pipeline().parameters.SourceTableName, ''', @LoadType = ''', pipeline().parameters.LoadType, '''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS RunId;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_UpdateWatermark] @TableID = ', string(pipeline().parameters.TableID), ', @NewWatermarkValue = ''', string(coalesce(json(activity('Web_Get_Run_Output').output.notebook_output.result).max_watermark_value, '')), '''; SELECT ''WatermarkUpdated'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = ', coalesce(variables('RowsCopied'), '0'), ', @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Child 2 Landing to Bronze/Raw Failed''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Child Pipeline 3: Cleanses and conforms raw Delta tables from bronze_catalog.raw_data into standardized dimensions and fact tables in silver_catalog.insurance_conformed using SCD Type 1 Upserts via Databricks Job.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Child3_Bronze_To_Silver'', @TableID = NULL, @TableName = ''All_Conformed_Tables'', @LoadType = ''Silver_Transform''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS RunId;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Child 3 Bronze to Silver Transformation Failed''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Child Pipeline 4: Aggregates conformed Silver models into curated Gold analytical marts (fact_policy_performance, fact_claims_settlement, monthly aggregates) and deploys reporting Semantic Views in gold_catalog.semantic_reporting via Databricks Job.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Child4_Silver_To_Gold'', @TableID = NULL, @TableName = ''All_Gold_Marts'', @LoadType = ''Gold_Analytics''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS RunId;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().parameters.BatchID, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Child 4 Silver to Gold Transformation or Semantic Deployment Failed''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Master Medallion Pipeline: Orchestrates the complete end-to-end data lifecycle from On-Prem SQL Server through Bronze (Raw Delta), Silver (Conformed Facts & Dimensions), Gold (Analytical Marts), and Semantic Reporting Views.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Master_Medallion_End_To_End'', @TableID = NULL, @TableName = ''Full_Medallion_Run'', @LoadType = ''', pipeline().parameters.LoadType, '''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS BatchID;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Master Medallion Pipeline Execution Encountered Failures''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Master Orchestrator Pipeline: Logs batch start, fetches active metadata from Azure SQL DB based on TriggerName and LoadType, and executes Child Pipelines 1 and 2 in parallel across tables.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Master_Metadata_Ingestion'', @TableID = NULL, @TableName = NULL, @LoadType = ''', pipeline().parameters.LoadType, '''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS BatchID;')

@concat('SELECT TableID, TriggerName, SourceSchema, SourceTableName, LoadType, WatermarkColumn, TargetContainerLanding, TargetContainerBronze, IsActive, SendAlert, PrimaryKeys, MandatoryColumns FROM [dbo].[IngestionMetadata] WHERE TriggerName = ''', pipeline().parameters.TriggerName, ''' AND LoadType = ''', pipeline().parameters.LoadType, ''' AND IsActive = ''Y'';')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Batch execution failed during metadata ingestion''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')

properties.description: Service Pipeline: Environment cleanup utility. Triggers Databricks Job to delete external ADLS Gen2 storage paths (Landing, Bronze) and drop Unity Catalog Delta tables in Azure Databricks without requiring interactive cluster creation permissions. Optionally resets watermarks and in-progress execution logs in Azure SQL.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC dbo.sp_ResetWatermark @SourceTableName = ', if(equals(toUpper(pipeline().parameters.TableName), 'ALL'), 'NULL', concat('''', pipeline().parameters.TableName, '''')), '; SELECT ''WatermarkReset'' AS Status;')

source.sqlReaderQuery: EXEC dbo.sp_ResetInProgressLogs @NewStatus = 'Cancelled', @ErrorMessage = 'Cleaned up by PL_Service_Cleanup_Tables'; SELECT 'LogsReset' AS Status;

properties.description: Full Load Bronze Sync Pipeline: Triggers Databricks Job to create Unity Catalog Landing Volumes (if not exists) and drops & recreates external tables in bronze_catalog.raw_data pointing to newly loaded Parquet files for full-load tables (CoverageTypes, Agents).

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineStart] @BatchID = ''', if(empty(pipeline().parameters.BatchID), pipeline().RunId, pipeline().parameters.BatchID), ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @PipelineName = ''PL_Sync_FullLoad_Bronze_Tables'', @TableID = NULL, @TableName = ''', pipeline().parameters.SourceTableName, ''', @LoadType = ''Full_Bronze_Sync''; SELECT ''', pipeline().RunId, ''' AS RunId;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', if(empty(pipeline().parameters.BatchID), pipeline().RunId, pipeline().parameters.BatchID), ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Success'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = NULL; SELECT ''Success'' AS Status;')

@concat('EXEC [dbo].[sp_LogPipelineEnd] @BatchID = ''', if(empty(pipeline().parameters.BatchID), pipeline().RunId, pipeline().parameters.BatchID), ''', @PipelineRunID = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @Status = ''Failed'', @RowsCopied = NULL, @ErrorMessage = ''Databricks Job Sync Full Load Bronze Failed''; SELECT ''Failed'' AS Status;')
